fusions.name: Snapped Slack
fusions.desc: Lashes a length of chain at the target for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and leaves it 20% slower for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Hook and Haul
fusions.desc: Hauls you up to 6 tiles along a hooked chain to the target and deals 13 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dragline
fusions.desc: Anchors a 5-tile line of chain ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Tethered Guard
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour is 10% higher.
